text:
Type: hanging planter with bamboo rod
Use: hanging a trailing plant from a ceiling hook or a rail; living room, kitchen, balcony
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: white plastic bowl, bamboo central rod, white metal hook
Colors: white, light warm bamboo
Shape: wide shallow round bowl with tapered sides, hung from a single upright bamboo rod in the middle ending in a curved hook, simple and graphic, light visual weight
Feel: fresh, clean, airy, natural
Goes with: trailing plants, light wood, white walls, rattan; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: BITTERGURKA
product.description: Hang your herbs by a window, then unhook and bring to the table or cooking pot for fresh herbs with every meal.
